decision.summary: Tenant gave one month's notice by email on 10 Oct for 10 Nov. Under the Renters' Rights Act it is invalid as given; two months applies, earliest end 10 Dec 2026. Replied to tenant and asked landlord whether he will agree in writing to an earlier date.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? Earliest end date?
answers.answer: No. Tenants must give two months' notice; earliest end date is 10 December 2026 (counting from 10 Oct).

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Landlord agrees in writing to a shorter notice/surrender by agreement (e.g. 10 Nov); or a mutually agreed date, possibly helped by an early re-let. Tenant cannot unilaterally shorten it.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied explaining two months, 10 Dec, early end only if landlord agrees in writing, keep keys for now, deposit handled via mydeposits after check-out. Started landlord approval request APR-102 and follow-up FUP-103 for 14 Oct.

conflicts: Tenant says one month's notice / 10 Nov; current law requires two months. Law trusted.
assumptions: Notice treated as served 10 Oct by email
Early end needs landlord's written agreement, which is not yet given

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job.

Since 1 May 2026 tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month's notice isn't enough to end the tenancy on 10 November. Counting from your email today (10 October), the earliest end date is 10 December 2026. Rent stays payable up to the day the tenancy ends.

If you need to leave sooner, your landlord can agree to an earlier end date, but only in writing. I'm asking them now and will tell you their answer. I can't promise they'll agree. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you've heard from us in writing.

Keys: please hold on to them for now. We'll confirm the handover details and a check-out appointment once the end date is settled.

Deposit: it's protected with mydeposits. Once the tenancy has ended and keys are back, we'll check the property against the check-in record and deal with the deposit through the scheme. I can't give an exact date yet, as it depends on the end date and the check-out.

You'll hear from us again by Wednesday 14 October.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
